subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated leads for {Brand} across the browse-to-message-to-transaction loop. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the validated lead, a buyer or seller contact confirmed real and reachable, read back through a platform-side check rather than the raw click. So the volume you pay for is qualified contacts that message and transact, with duplicate, bot, and synthetic-identity traffic screened out before the lead counts. If it helps, I can pull the category-level and metro-level lead-quality read we are seeing. Open to a quick look?
register_notes: Stage 1 EN classifieds: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates one proof from parent (validated-lead optimization + platform-side S2S check + dedupe/bot/synthetic-identity screen); soft CTA; exactly one question mark; no MobUpps figure used this stage; no sign-off; native US business English; no 'X, not Y' (stated positively as 'rather than the raw click').
